brief.headline: Trade payment speed for a price cut: offer to pay them 15 days faster (freeing ₹26.60 L cash for us) in exchange for a discount near their 12.16% borrowing cost.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut of around 10–12%, in exchange for paying 15 days faster.
priceAsk.target: A discount near their 12.16% borrowing cost
priceAsk.basis: Their cash is stuck for 101d (vs 64d at similar firms), they borrow money at about 12.16%, and the open market shows pharma laminate asking prices at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg) — so room exists to negotiate down while still staying in the fair band, especially when we pay faster.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days faster than our current 30 Days After Receipt, conditional on the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹26.60 L cash for us, but their borrowing cost (12.16%) makes early payment worth more to them — so we trade that value for a price cut.

brief.financialLeverage: They are middling health (C 46/100) with a CARE BBB+ / Stable rating, and they keep only 2.3% as profit. They owe a lot — 1.25× their own cash — and their cash is stuck for 101d (vs 64d at similar firms), so cash is tight for them. We are 0.61% of their ₹1064.86 Cr revenue, so a small but meaningful customer. Push on payment terms and a modest price cut; avoid a squeeze that risks supply, but they will value faster payment and we have credible second sources lined up.

risks: They show EPF payment delays — watch for any supply hiccups and keep a second source qualified.
Credit rating is middling (CARE BBB+ / Stable) and health score is C (46/100) with a grey-zone distress signal (Altman Z 2.36) — don't push so hard you tip a fragile supplier.
Very thin profit (2.3%) means a big price cut could hurt them — frame the ask around faster payment, not a straight squeeze.
They take 51d to pay their own suppliers (vs 40d at similar firms), so they already stretch cash — use that to justify asking for faster payment from us only if we get a price cut in return.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to help free up cash for you by paying 15 days faster — in exchange, we're looking for a price cut that reflects the 12% cost of money and brings us closer to the ₹205–250/kg band we see in the market.
